from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TradingFinancialAssets(BaseModel):
    """Trading financial assets reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock security code if available")
    assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The trading financial assets amount in yuan")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report is as of, e.g., 2024-03-31")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., 元")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    trading_financial_assets_records: list[TradingFinancialAssets]
